requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Residential College Arts & Ideas Major department(s).

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: RCHUMS 201: How to Think (Humanities)
requirements.hint: How to Think in the Arts and Humanities, Humanities course.

requirements.label: RCHUMS 202: How to Think (Arts)
requirements.hint: How to Think in the Arts and Humanities, Arts course.

requirements.label: Core Humanities: 6 Credits
requirements.hint: Must be fulfilled by courses specifically designed to treat at least two art forms, per the official course list on the LSA bulletin page for the Arts & Ideas in the Humanities major (effective Winter 2022, checked July 2026). Cross-listed codes printed in the bulletin are included.

requirements.label: Core Arts: 6 Credits
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Core Arts requires 6 credits of courses that focus on the practice of visual art, music, drama, film, or creative writing, chosen from appropriate offerings in RCHUMS, RCARTS, RCMUSIC, and across the university at the 200 level or above, selected in consultation with the Arts and Ideas advisor. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Focus: 15 Credits
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. The Focus requires 15 credits of courses that converge around a single art form in deep historical and theoretical context, or two art forms in relation to each other, chosen from offerings in RCARTS, RCHUMS, RCMUSIC, and across the university at the 300 level or above; the rationale for course selections must be approved by the Arts and Ideas advisor. RC Language Readings courses may count, and with advisor approval courses taken abroad may also count. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits
requirements.hint: Minimum 33 credits. Includes all courses used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments (audited here as RCHUMS courses).

requirements.label: Major Residency Requirement
requirements.hint: minimum 20 credits of major coursework taken in residence at U-M.
